name: BudCo Electric
old_description: When your home or business needs reliable electrical work done right the first time, you want a licensed, local electrician who actually shows up on time and stands behind the work. From electrical panel upgrades and EV charger installation to 24-hour emergency electrical services, our licensed team handles it all, safely, cleanly, and at fair prices.
about:
BudCo Electric operates from Colorado Springs, Colorado, serving residential and commercial customers across El Paso County. The locally owned electrical contracting company has been active in the community for years, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated. Its team of licensed electricians lives and works in the same neighborhoods they serve, from older downtown districts with aging wiring to newer subdivisions in Briargate and Stetson Hills and rural properties in Black Forest and Peyton.

The company provides a full scope of electrical contracting services. Core offerings include electrical panel replacements and upgrades, subpanel installations, EV charger installation with dedicated circuits, residential wiring and rewiring for remodels and older homes, indoor lighting and ceiling fan installation, whole-home surge protection at the main panel, standby generator installation, and 24-hour emergency response for both residential and commercial clients. Commercial work covers tenant improvements, office build-outs, exterior lighting, and three-phase power upgrades. Most panel replacements are completed in a single day.

BudCo Electric serves homeowners, landlords, builders, business owners, property managers, and general contractors throughout Colorado Springs and the greater El Paso County area. The company regularly works in zip codes spanning central, east, north, and northeast Colorado Springs, as well as Black Forest, Monument, Security-Widefield, Fort Carson, Fountain, Cimarron Hills, Gleneagle, and Peyton. Military families and civilians in the Fort Carson area are noted among its clientele.

The company emphasizes doing work right the first time with no shortcuts, providing straight answers and transparent pricing before work begins, and respecting customers' homes by showing up on time, using boot covers, protecting floors and walls, and leaving job sites cleaner than they were found. It positions itself as a neighbor-first business that keeps money local and supports Colorado tradespeople.
